entities.summary: Jorge Luis Bonifacio is a Dominican-American professional baseball outfielder for the Cleburne Railroaders of the American Association of Professional Baseball. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Kansas City Royals, Detroit Tigers, and Philadelphia Phillies.
